sourceDesign.provenanceNote: Seven approved references exported uncropped from the source Pencil document at 2x. adujr, s5TRC and xbIxj are the amendment request, corrected-result review and League correction history frames; CWJkF is the existing dispute frame re-used for dispute resolution (byte-identical to the PAF-8 export). SluH3 (Platform Admin repair diagnostics, desktop dark 1280x1500), cuVwp (mobile light 390x2250) and Jjrtb (mobile dark 390x2250) were added to the design by the product owner after the first PAF-14 certification and replace the earlier "no diagnostics frame" gap. The source digest was re-pinned to the design bytes that contain the three new frames. Before re-pinning, adujr, s5TRC, CWJkF and xbIxj were re-exported through Pencil at scale 2 and matched their approved PNG SHA-256 byte-for-byte, and the four frames kept their names and 390x844 sizes: the design change is additions only. The design has no desktop-light diagnostics frame (only desktop dark plus mobile light and dark): the implemented desktop-light rendering carries structural, accessibility and locale gates only, and no raster comparison (design gap observation, not a defect).

visualBudgets.measurementMethod: Capture at reference pixelSize / 2 using Chromium deviceScaleFactor 1. Downsample only the uncropped 2x Pencil PNG. Compare same-size RGBA pixels with the pinned perceptual threshold (35215 x 0.1^2); reject any dimension mismatch. Two scoped measurements: (1) perRegion = top-left aligned crop of one comparable surface; corner squares (cornerRadius), the edge band (edgeInset, production border), production text/control/filled-child boxes (+2px) and the reference foreground pixels (+2px dilation) are excluded, the reference modal fill must equal the recorded fill, and at least minComparedRegionFraction of the crop must remain compared; (2) perScreen mode "masked" = whole viewport with every production block inside main and every referenceMasks rect (+1px) removed (what remains is page background and gutters); mode "excluded" = no whole-screen raster because a declared adaptation covers the whole viewport.

adujr.rationale: Whole-screen compare on the unmasked remainder (page background and gutters) after masking every production block in main and every Pencil block. Measured 0 (full-frame unmasked difference 0.1775-0.1854 is composition, declared below). Masked cap = highest measured + about 0.02.

s5TRC.rationale: Same method. Measured 0 (full-frame difference 0.1659 is composition, declared below).

CWJkF.rationale: Declared adaptation C1: production shows a modal over a dimmed match detail, the frame is a full page. The backdrop covers the whole viewport, so no whole-screen raster is meaningful. The dialog surface is raster-compared per region and the layout is covered by structural probes.

xbIxj.rationale: Same method. Measured 0 (full-frame difference 0.1153 is composition, declared below).

cuVwp.rationale: Declared adaptations E1-E3: the route is a live platform queue (real job count, sorting, scheduler health and 10s refresh) in one centered 480px column, while the frame is a static composition (fixed four jobs, side detail panel on desktop, inline confirmation and queue-state cards). Whole-screen raster is excluded; comparable surfaces are raster-compared per region and the layout is covered by structural probes.

Jjrtb.rationale: Declared adaptations E1-E3: the route is a live platform queue (real job count, sorting, scheduler health and 10s refresh) in one centered 480px column, while the frame is a static composition (fixed four jobs, side detail panel on desktop, inline confirmation and queue-state cards). SluH3.rationale: Declared adaptations E1-E3: the route is a live platform queue (real job count, sorting, scheduler health and 10s refresh) in one centered 480px column, while the frame is a static composition (fixed four jobs, side detail panel on desktop, inline confirmation and queue-state cards). visualBudgets.minComparedRegionFractionReason: Guard so the exclusions (text, controls, filled nested surfaces, corners, borders) can never leave a region compared on a token share of its area. Lowest measured share is 0.155 (CWJkF resolutionSurface: the dialog now carries three filled option rows that are excluded); guard 0.12 keeps about 0.03 headroom.
visualBudgets.maskPolicy: Whole-screen raster (masked mode) removes every production block inside main and every listed Pencil block, so it compares only page background and gutters. No element is silently hidden: each masked Pencil element is listed in inventory.<frame> and is either asserted by the computed-style typography/color/geometry contract in frame-reference.json (probed) or mapped to a declared adaptation that names its covering probes (adapted). Dynamic production values (live names, dates, scores, job ids) are never compared by pixels; their typography is asserted through the contract.

geometryReference.source: Element rectangles flood-filled from the uncropped 2x Pencil PNGs and halved to 1x (see perRegion.reference and referenceMasks). Every block in all four frames is 354px wide at x=18 (18px gutters on a 390px frame), blocks are 10px apart, actions are 44px high, dialog-style option rows are 44px high 9px apart.

declaredAdaptations.note: Production composition that intentionally differs from the static Pencil frames. Each adaptation lists composition probes per capture state (renderer-independent DOM assertions of element order, adjacency/alignment and localized content identity) that the frame tests run through an exact-set registry; assertInventory fails an adaptation without a covering probe. Elements that have a production counterpart are additionally asserted by the computed-style contract in frame-reference.json (every allowance is a token expression that must resolve exactly and must really differ from the frame). Elements without a counterpart are listed in inventory.<frame>.adapted.
